title: The Flying Pig | 5BR Gulf Front Rental | Royal Destinations
meta_description: The Flying Pig is a luxury 5BR Gulf-front Grayton Beach home with a private pool and stunning views. This signature 30A rental sleeps 14 by Royal Destinations.
description_expanded: Description: The Flying Pig by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 46 Majestica Circle, Santa Rosa Beach Details: Welcome to our newest Gulf front home, The Flying Pig: a true dream destination on 30A. This nearly 5,000 square feet main and attached carriage house is stunning. Guests searching for coastal luxury right in the heart of 30A will fall in love with the heart-stopping views, private beachfront access, and spacious accommodations. To top it off, there is a private community pool for this gated subdivision, just steps from this home. There is room for everyone to soak in the views from just about everywhere in this natural light-filled beauty. Gather in the grand spaces with everyone for memory making or retreat to your private room to relax and unwind. Enjoy the spacious balconies, large deck and private boardwalk to the beach. The Flying Pig takes full advantage of its beach frontage. From the new decor to the amazing outdoor spaces, this home is sure to impress. Simply relax and watch the sun set over the Gulf of Mexico. This home is ideal for multi-generational family vacations, family reunions, corporate retreats, multiple family trips, and girlfriend's getaway. This home has space for everyone. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 17 6 Bedrooms / 5 Full Baths / 2 Half Baths First Floor: - Guest Room 1: Bunk Room (Twin/Twin Bunk Bed and Single Twin Bed) - Great Room / Dining Room / Kitchen / 2 Half Baths / Large Deck / Private Boardwalk - Front Row Views -Laundry room Second Floor: - Guest Room 2: Master Bedroom, Private Bath with Soaking Tub and Separate Shower and Double Vanity - Guest Room 3: Master Bedroom, Private Bath with Shower and Double Vanity - Guest Room 4: King Bedroom, Private Bath with Shower - Guest Room 5: Queen Bedroom, Private Bath with Shower Attached Carriage House: - Guest Room 6: Bunk Room with 3 Sets of Twin/Twin Beds - Loft with Double Bed - Kitchenette Third Floor Viewing and Sun Deck: - Beverage Center Amenities Include: - 6 Adult Bikes - Beach Towel Service -2 Beach Service Sets* *Seasonal: March – October Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
